objective: Resolve one bounded batch of the three oldest remaining Scout INDEX entries marked Not yet sourced, using source-backed canonical integration or an evidence-backed no-op for each entry.
context: The 2026-09-01 read-only health assessment counted 222 Not yet sourced markers, unchanged for 34 observer windows.
This goal is intentionally limited to three entries; it does not authorize clearing markers in bulk or treating the entire backlog as one change.
Select the three oldest markers by declared source-observation date, then by finding path, from the preserved execution revision. Record that selection before editing.
The current /app checkout has user-owned edits to INDEX.md and multiple canonical notes. Preserve those changes as a revision and reconcile them in an isolated worktree before any edit.
acceptance: The owner-maintained Scout library state is preserved as an explicit revision, and the goal-owned branch/worktree begins from that revision.
A pre-edit table names exactly three selected INDEX entries, their finding paths, source URLs or stable IDs, existing related canonical sections, and duplicate-search results.

For each selected entry, verified useful claims are integrated into no more than two appropriate canonical notes and its INDEX marker is updated, or a concrete no-op explains why the source cannot support a safe integration.
Claims retain source URLs or stable identifiers and preserve uncertainty; inaccessible sources are reported rather than simulated.

Link/reference checks, relevant focused tests, and the read-only library-health assessment pass on the final revision. The final assessment and exact backlog count are recorded without claiming the whole backlog is resolved.
The final diff contains only the three dispositions, at most two canonical notes, INDEX.md, and one bounded verification report, and is reviewed path by path.
constraints: Do not edit or run write-capable commands in /app or another worker's worktree.
Do not broaden the batch beyond three entries, remove markers without canonical integration evidence, or fabricate source validation.
External checks are read-only and must not change services, schedules, task state, credentials, or delivery channels.
Do not access XHS unless credential-ready:xhs is independently observed ready and a selected entry genuinely requires it; otherwise disposition that entry as waiting and select no replacement.
Reconcile the preserved owner revision before touching INDEX.md or any canonical note.
